family_reports.body: Boise CPS Rachael Lara & Saira Locke, Jennifer Flatt, judge Andrew Ellis the do no investigation, make tons of false allegations without investigation leads to job loss, attorney fees, and a 16 year old that is thought to tell no lies and they have given her all control of the case
I tried to ask for help and justice for child molestation, and instead, I have spent 7 years without my daughter. And another 5 until she's 18.

The courts have protected the abuser of my children and I, allowed unlawful hearings/filings and orders without my knowledge, refused our civil/constitutional/due process rights, in Washington State and Idaho. My children have spent the last six years never knowing when or where their abusive biological father will show up. Their last few years of childhood/teenage years have been extremely difficult to have joy as hearing have been scheduled ongoing, my preparation of answering motions/filings as pro se takes a tremendous amount of time away from my children/teenagers, continues to take a toll on my health with diagnosis of ADHD/CPTSD/Anxiety/Depression/Battered Wife Syndrome/Lupus/Connective Tissue Disorder/Fibromyalgia brought on by the massive stress from the abusive litigation I'm encountering. Our family finances have been very very strained leaving my teenagers and I below poverty, on state assistance, needing help from others, not meeting our most basic needs. My children/teenagers have anger management issues, SPD/ADHD/Anxiety/ODD/Depression/CPTSD, fear of being forced again and again to face their abusive biological father through reunification or placed in his/his enabling families custody. The judges made it known that no matter what this abusive man has done to me or our children/teenagers he will be reunited and I will be forced to endure as many hearings as he drags me through for as long as he wants and pay for all of it. My family has lost almost everything! These judges use their immunity to abuse people and families like mine, torture us, financially abuse us, steal years of goodness with our children away, creating a dead lock in our lives, approving coercive control, supplying a way to force mothers and children/teenagers bond to grow thin by applying pressure to how long we can endure the evil corruption. I have begged for help from advocacy offices, attorneys, judges, and no one has been willing or able to help my family. Now the Idaho courts are ignoring the laws, will not provide protection for us, nor stop the vexatious litigation from my abusive ex-husband or his attorneys. My children/teenagers and I are facing losing our house, what health we have left, our dignity and happiness. The only way we have barely made it this far is because we have faith in God.
